title: [docdb] Potential deadlock in yb::client::YBTable::MaybeRefreshPartitions
body:
Investigation started from a TS not heartbeating to the master. This normally is due to some raft lock being held, which was the case here too
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911f  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b66b39  __lll_lock_wait
    @     0x7ffb63b616e2  __GI___pthread_mutex_lock
    @     0x7ffb71b840da  yb::consensus::ReplicaState::LockForRead()
    @     0x7ffb71b87a7e  yb::consensus::ReplicaState::GetLeaderState()
    @     0x7ffb71b5f387  yb::consensus::RaftConsensus::GetLeaderState()
    @     0x7ffb72804ad4  yb::tserver::LeaderTerm()
    @     0x7ffb7283d466  yb::tserver::TabletSplitHeartbeatDataProvider::DoAddData()
    @     0x7ffb727d2514  yb::tserver::Heartbeater::Thread::TryHeartbeat()
    @     0x7ffb727d3722  yb::tserver::Heartbeater::Thread::DoHeartbeat()
    @     0x7ffb727d3af4  yb::tserver::Heartbeater::Thread::RunThread()
    @     0x7ffb693496ce  yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
    @     0x7ffb63b5f693  start_thread
    @     0x7ffb6329c41c  __clone
    @ 0xffffffffffffffff  (unknown)
```

Only relevant place to hold the lock while not doing something trivial, pointed to some MetaCache call
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911e  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b6400c  __pthread_cond_wait
    @     0x7ffb74bc8c12  boost::shared_mutex::lock_shared()
    @     0x7ffb6f6cf218  yb::client::internal::MetaCache::DoLookupTabletById<>()
    @     0x7ffb6f6bd280  yb::client::internal::MetaCache::LookupTabletById()
    @     0x7ffb6f63ad3e  yb::client::YBClient::LookupTabletById()
    @     0x7ffb6f6fb74b  yb::client::internal::TabletInvoker::Execute()
    @     0x7ffb71f51a46  yb::tablet::TransactionParticipant::Impl::NotifyApplied()
    @     0x7ffb71f52069  yb::tablet::TransactionParticipant::Impl::ProcessApply()
    @     0x7ffb71f3f86d  yb::tablet::TransactionParticipant::ProcessReplicated()
    @     0x7ffb71f69c9b  yb::tablet::UpdateTxnOperation::DoReplicated()
    @     0x7ffb71f5807a  yb::tablet::Operation::Replicated()
    @     0x7ffb71f6029f  yb::tablet::OperationDriver::ApplyTask()
    @     0x7ffb71f6060b  yb::tablet::OperationDriver::ApplyOperation()
    @     0x7ffb71f60bf7  yb::tablet::OperationDriver::ReplicationFinished()
    @     0x7ffb71b28a97  yb::consensus::ConsensusRound::NotifyReplicationFinished()
```

Searching for other MetaCache related threads, most seemed harmless, stuck in some form of lookup by key or ID, like `yb::client::internal::MetaCache::DoLookupTabletById`, except for two of them:

One thread was a clear callback path, for processing updated tablet locations:
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911f  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b6400c  __pthread_cond_wait
    @     0x7ffb74bc935b  boost::shared_mutex::lock()
    @     0x7ffb6f6bebbc  yb::client::internal::MetaCache::ProcessTabletLocations()
    @     0x7ffb6f6d1ad1  yb::client::internal::LookupByKeyRpc::ProcessTabletLocations()
    @     0x7ffb6f6cc932  yb::client::internal::LookupRpc::DoFinished<>()
    @     0x7ffb6f6c15e0  std::_Function_handler<>::_M_invoke()
    @     0x7ffb6aad952d  yb::rpc::OutboundCall::InvokeCallbackSync()
    @     0x7ffb6aad9748  yb::rpc::InvokeCallbackTask::Run()
    @     0x7ffb6ab35ea7  yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
    @     0x7ffb693496ce  yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
    @     0x7ffb63b5f693  start_thread
    @     0x7ffb6329c41c  __clone
    @ 0xffffffffffffffff  (unknown)
```

The other was stuck in a seemingly trivial getter on YBTable
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911e  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b6746c  __GI___nanosleep
    @     0x7ffb6f6e4b31  yb::client::YBTable::FindPartitionStartIndex()
    @     0x7ffb6f6e4c2e  yb::client::YBTable::FindPartitionStart()
    @     0x7ffb6f6d07bc  yb::client::internal::MetaCache::DoLookupTabletByKey<>()
    @     0x7ffb6f6bd9a7  yb::client::internal::MetaCache::LookupTabletByKey()
    @     0x7ffb6f636a9f  yb::client::internal::Batcher::Add()
    @     0x7ffb6f6db5c2  yb::client::YBSession::Apply()
    @     0x7ffb7396ef32  yb::ql::Executor::AddOperation()
    @     0x7ffb7396f37a  yb::ql::Executor::ExecPTNode()
    @     0x7ffb7397013f  yb::ql::Executor::ExecTreeNode()
    @     0x7ffb7397113c  yb::ql::Executor::ProcessAsyncResults()
    @     0x7ffb73971a87  yb::ql::Executor::FlushAsyncDone()
    @     0x7ffb73972130  _ZN5boost6detail8function26void_function_obj_invoker1IZN2yb2ql8Executor10FlushAsyncEvEUlRKNS3_6StatusEE0_vS8_E6invokeERNS1_15function_bufferES8_
    @     0x7ffb6f6341c5  _ZNSt17_Function_handlerIFvvEZN2yb6client8internal7Batcher11RunCallbackERKNS1_6StatusEEUlvE_E9_M_invokeERKSt9_Any_data
    @     0x7ffb6f634418  yb::client::internal::Batcher::RunCallback()
```

Digging further into YBTable related threads, there were a number of also seemingly trivial getters stuck
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911f  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b6746c  __GI___nanosleep
    @     0x7ffb6f6e4842  yb::client::YBTable::GetPartitionsVersion()
    @     0x7ffb6f6cc554  yb::client::internal::LookupRpc::DoFinished<>()
    @     0x7ffb6f6c15e0  std::_Function_handler<>::_M_invoke()
    @     0x7ffb6aad952d  yb::rpc::OutboundCall::InvokeCallbackSync()
    @     0x7ffb6aad9748  yb::rpc::InvokeCallbackTask::Run()
    @     0x7ffb6ab35ea7  yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
    @     0x7ffb693496ce  yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
    @     0x7ffb63b5f693  start_thread
    @     0x7ffb6329c41c  __clone
    @ 0xffffffffffffffff  (unknown)

Total number of threads: 7
```

As well as finally two very relevant threads stuck in `MaybeRefreshPartitions`:
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911e  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b66b39  __lll_lock_wait
    @     0x7ffb63b616e1  __GI___pthread_mutex_lock
    @     0x7ffb6f6e9ea9  yb::client::YBTable::MaybeRefreshPartitions()
    @     0x7ffb6f7239d3  yb::client::YBOperation::MaybeRefreshTablePartitions()
    @     0x7ffb6f6365f7  yb::client::internal::Batcher::Add()
    @     0x7ffb6f6db5c2  yb::client::YBSession::Apply()
    @     0x7ffb7396ef32  yb::ql::Executor::AddOperation()
    @     0x7ffb7396f37a  yb::ql::Executor::ExecPTNode()
    @     0x7ffb7397013f  yb::ql::Executor::ExecTreeNode()
    @     0x7ffb7397113c  yb::ql::Executor::ProcessAsyncResults()
    @     0x7ffb73971a87  yb::ql::Executor::FlushAsyncDone()
    @     0x7ffb73972130  _ZN5boost6detail8function26void_function_obj_invoker1IZN2yb2ql8Executor10FlushAsyncEvEUlRKNS3_6StatusEE0_vS8_E6invokeERNS1_15function_bufferES8_
    @     0x7ffb6f6341c5  _ZNSt17_Function_handlerIFvvEZN2yb6client8internal7Batcher11RunCallbackERKNS1_6StatusEEUlvE_E9_M_invokeERKSt9_Any_data
    @     0x7ffb6f634418  yb::client::internal::Batcher::RunCallback()
    @     0x7ffb6f63473a  yb::client::internal::Batcher::CheckForFinishedFlush()

Total number of threads: 1
```
vs
```
    @     0x7ffb631e911e  (unknown)
    @     0x7ffb63b6746c  __GI___nanosleep
    @     0x7ffb6f6ea1ce  yb::client::YBTable::MaybeRefreshPartitions()
    @     0x7ffb6f7239d3  yb::client::YBOperation::MaybeRefreshTablePartitions()
    @     0x7ffb6f6365f7  yb::client::internal::Batcher::Add()
    @     0x7ffb6f6db5c2  yb::client::YBSession::Apply()
    @     0x7ffb7396ef32  yb::ql::Executor::AddOperation()
    @     0x7ffb7396f37a  yb::ql::Executor::ExecPTNode()
    @     0x7ffb7397013f  yb::ql::Executor::ExecTreeNode()
    @     0x7ffb73970340  yb::ql::Executor::Execute()
    @     0x7ffb7397083d  yb::ql::Executor::ExecuteAsync()
    @     0x7ffb73dc7308  yb::ql::QLProcessor::ExecuteAsync()
    @     0x7ffb74bc4153  yb::cqlserver::CQLProcessor::ProcessRequest()
    @     0x7ffb74bc48fc  yb::cqlserver::CQLProcessor::ProcessRequest()
    @     0x7ffb74bc4d78  yb::cqlserver::CQLProcessor::ProcessCall()
    @     0x7ffb74bdfe0a  yb::cqlserver::CQLServiceImpl::Handle()
```

Now, this is supposed to be serially executed, so one of these being stuck is expected! But that means the other one, that is supposed to be doing work, is stuck unexpectedly... Most likely, the culprit is `YBTable::FetchPartitions`, which does a call to the master to fetch the new partitions, but then on the callback path, is likely stuck in one of the callback paths above, where it is trying to get a lock, while already under a lock...

cc @robertsami
